name: Bone Crusher (Combat)
body:
With the blunt head of your weapon you can destroy the bones and nerves of arms, feet, hands, and legs.

Benefit: You can attempt to sever limbs using a bludgeoning weapon.

Normal: You can only attempt to sever limbs using a slashing weapon.
